title.zh: Chainalysis：以太坊重组触发THORChain紧急暂停，延迟洗钱
title.en: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder

current_state.zh: THORChain 金库已因用户退回 10 ETH 恢复偿付能力，但多数受影响链的交易仍处于紧急暂停状态，核心开发团队正在修复，节点运营商将在确认各链安全后决定是否重新启用。
current_state.en: THORChain treasury solvency has been restored after a user returned the 10 ETH, but trading remains paused across most affected chains while core developers work on fixes and node operators decide whether to re-enable each chain after safety checks.

updates.title_zh: Chainalysis：以太坊重组触发THORChain紧急暂停，延迟洗钱
updates.title_en: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder
updates.what_changed_zh: Chainalysis报告称，10月31日上午的一次以太坊重组导致THORChain对一笔10 ETH存款错误地进行了双重退款，引发紧急暂停，切断了其大多数桥接器上所有用户的跨链兑换，并意外拖延了从币安窃取资金的洗钱活动。
updates.what_changed_en: Chainalysis reported that an Ethereum reorganization on the morning of October 31 caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund on a 10 ETH deposit, prompting an emergency pause that cut off cross-chain swaps across most of its bridges for all users and inadvertently stalled laundering of funds stolen from Binance.

updates.title_zh: THORChain：某用户主动退回10枚ETH，金库已恢复偿付能力
updates.title_en: THORChain：某用户主动退回10枚ETH，金库已恢复偿付能力
updates.what_changed_zh: THORChain 表示，误付的 10 ETH 已由用户主动退回，金库恢复偿付能力；但 AVAX、BASE、RUNE、XRPL 之外的多条链交易仍暂停，包括 ATOM、BCH、BSC、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、SOL、TRON、ZEC，待核心开发团队修复并由节点运营商确认安全后决定是否重启。
updates.what_changed_en: THORChain said the erroneously paid 10 ETH was voluntarily returned by a user and treasury solvency was restored; however, trading remained paused on ten chains—ATOM, BCH, BSC, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, SOL, TRON and ZEC—while AVAX, BASE, RUNE and XRPL stayed active, pending fixes and node-operator safety confirmation before re-enabling.
updates.current_state_zh: THORChain 金库已因用户退回 10 ETH 恢复偿付能力，但多数受影响链的交易仍处于紧急暂停状态，核心开发团队正在修复，节点运营商将在确认各链安全后决定是否重新启用。
updates.current_state_en: THORChain treasury solvency has been restored after a user returned the 10 ETH, but trading remains paused across most affected chains while core developers work on fixes and node operators decide whether to re-enable each chain after safety checks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: THORChain resumed treasury solvency after a user returned 10 ETH that was erroneously paid out following an Ethereum block reorganization, while trading remained paused across ten chains pending safety checks and fixes.
updates.detailed_summary_en: THORChain resumed treasury solvency after a user returned 10 ETH that was erroneously paid out following an Ethereum block reorganization, while trading remained paused across ten chains pending safety checks and fixes.
